## Listen

```{.r}
hear("gin khao?")

literal_meaning <- "Have you eaten?"

meaning <- connection
```

---

## Translate

```{.r}
translate("mai pen rai")

# "no problem"
# "it's okay"
# "never mind"
# "don't worry about it"

understand("mai pen rai")
```

---

## Speak

```{.r}
while (!fluent) {

  speak()
  make_mistakes()
  ask_questions()
  practice()

}
```

---

## Notice

```{.r}
sobremesa <- "time together at the table after a meal"

describe_in_english(sobremesa)

name_in_spanish(sobremesa)
```

---

## See Differently

```{.r}
english <- "I forgot it."

spanish <- "Se me olvidó."

# Same experience.
# Differently structured.
```

---

## A New Language

```{.r}
translate("repository")
translate("commit")
translate("relative path")
translate("function")
```

---

## Practice

```{.r}
repeat {

  try()
  make_mistakes()
  ask_questions()
  try_again()

}
```

---

## Eventually...

```{.r}
# You stop translating.

think_in_reproducibility()
```

---

## Notice Differently

```{.r}
notice("I'm doing this manually.")

notice("I should document this.")

notice("Someone else should be able to reproduce this.")

notice("I should commit this before I change it.")
```

---

## Think

```{.r}
while (solving_problem) {

  if (old_language_works) {
    use(old_language)
  }

  if (new_language_reveals_something) {
    think_differently()
  }

}
```

---

## Dream

```{.r}
dream(in = "new language")
```
